2: Among $n$ people there are Ania and her two friends. All these $n$ people are lined up one behind another. The number of all such arrangements is 12 times greater than the number of all such arrangements of these $n$ people in a line in which Ania and her two friends occupy three consecutive places (in any order). Compute $n$. Show your working.
3: The probability that a heating-network failure occurs in the morning hours on a single day at a certain housing estate equals $0.1$. Compute the probability of event $A$ that, in a period of seven days, there will be at most two days on which this network fails in the morning hours at this estate. Give the result as a decimal rounded to hundredths. Show your working.
4: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=2x^3-4x^2+9x$ for every real number $x$. The point $P=(x_0,18)$ belongs to the graph of $f$. Compute $x_0$ and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of $f$ at point $P$. Show your working.
7: Given is the infinite geometric series $2x-\dfrac{6x}{x-1}+\dfrac{18x}{(x-1)^2}-\dfrac{54x}{(x-1)^3}+\dots$. Find all values of the variable $x$ (different from $0$ and from $1$) for which the sum of this series exists and equals $\dfrac{15}{2}$. Show your working.
8: Solve the equation $\sin(5x)+\cos x=0$ in the set $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$. Show your working.
9: Triangle $ABC$ is inscribed in the circle with equation $(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=25$. Side $AB$ of this triangle is contained in the line with equation $4x-3y+2=0$. The altitude $CD$ of this triangle divides side $AB$ so that $|AD|=4\cdot|DB|$. Compute the area of triangle $ABC$. Show your working.
11: The sequence $(a,b,c)$ is a three-term geometric sequence with positive terms. The sequence $(2a,2b,c+1)$ is a three-term arithmetic sequence. Moreover, the condition $c-b=6$ is satisfied. Compute $a$, $b$ and $c$. Show your working.
12: A convex quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in a circle of radius $4$. Angles $BAD$ and $BCD$ are right angles (see figure). The diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of this quadrilateral intersect at point $E$ so that $|BE|=3\cdot|DE|$ and $|BD|=2\cdot|AE|$. Compute the lengths of the sides of quadrilateral $ABCD$. Show your working.
